name: The Chase
source:
The criminal underworld has been abuzz about the Black Label Protocore collection that has finally surfaced after months of speculation. All the intel points to one location: the annual Mobsters & Monsters Masquerade.  

So you thought you'd dress in a crow-themed outfit to find out what he knows about it. 

...What do you mean there's other party goers also wearing crow-themed costumes? Oh well, that's the least of my problems.

[From [url=https://sippyswoon.itch.io/the-chase]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
近几个月来猜测纷纷的“黑标芯核”藏品终于重现江湖，整个地下犯罪世界为此沸沸扬扬。所有情报都指向同一个地点：一年一度的“黑帮与魔物”假面舞会。

于是你盘算着穿上一身乌鸦主题礼服潜入舞会，打探他对此究竟知道多少内幕。

……等等，你说派对上还有其他宾客也穿了乌鸦主题装扮是什么意思？算了，眼下这还算不上我最头疼的麻烦。

[摘自[url=https://sippyswoon.itch.io/the-chase]itch.io[/url]]
